On Saturday February 22nd Bill Couzens held another Jumble Sale and even surprised himself by raising the record amount of £123.67 for Club funds. Our thanks to Bill, his wife Gwen and all those members and relations who helped to make this such a success.
Gwen thinks he's mad but ... Bill has decided that he can't let go just yet and will continue as the organiser of our premier social function.
